verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Database Webhooks that fire on table INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE events. They are built on triggers and pg_net and deliver payloads over HTTP to any endpoint, including Edge Functions, which the docs say can be used for listening to webhooks. This covers automatic function execution on database events. Missing for 10: any evidence of auth-event triggers (e.g., auth hooks on signup/login), and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook-to-function reliability.
